name: 1 Apr 1962

references.label: Ministry of Health and Local Government Provisional Order Confirmation (Bangor Borough Extension) Act (Northern Ireland) 1962 (1962 c. i)
references.note: Local Act confirming a Bangor Borough (Extension) Order. Royal Assent 13 Feb 1962 (Belfast Gazette issue 2121, 16 Feb 1962, page 59). Appointed day 1 Apr 1962, as printed in the confirmed Order. Bangor borough extended.

references.label: Ministry of Health and Local Government Provisional Order Confirmation (Coleraine Borough Extension) Act (Northern Ireland) 1962 (1962 c. ii)
references.note: Local Act confirming the Coleraine Borough (Extension) Order (Northern Ireland) 1961. Royal Assent 20 Dec 1962 (Belfast Gazette issue 2166, 28 Dec 1962, page 493). The confirmed Order prints an appointed day of 1 Apr 1962, earlier than Royal Assent, and the change counts from that day: the Census of Population 1966, Preliminary Report (HMSO Belfast, 1967) and General Report, changes in administrative areas, https://www.nisra.gov.uk/publications/1966-census-reports, record the transfer of part of Coleraine Rural District to Coleraine Municipal Borough on 1 Apr 1962. Coleraine borough extended.

references.label: Census of Population 1966: General Report
references.note: North Down RD (population 477 in 1961) to Bangor MB 1 Apr 1962; Bangor MB 2,664 ac 2 r 37 p.

references.label: Census of Population 1966: Preliminary Report
references.note: Changes in administrative areas: Co. Antrim (1), town of Antrim; Co. Down (2), Bangor MB; Co. Londonderry (1), Coleraine RD to Coleraine MB (population 598 in 1961), all 1 Apr 1962.

references.label: Belfast Gazette, issue 2125, 16 March 1962, p. 97
references.note: as a separate change only: Orders in Council under s.11 Boundary Survey (Ireland) Act 1854 confirming alterations in boundaries in Co. Antrim and Belfast County Borough, effective 1 Apr 1962 (reports and Ordnance plans lodged with the Clerk of the Crown and Peace); not drawn.

approximateSegments.note: Some lines on this map are approximate: parts of the Armagh urban district boundary are traced from the map deposited with the 1946 Order (about 20 m); parts of the Lurgan borough boundary are traced from the 1956 Order's plan (about 25 m); parts of the Bangor borough boundary are traced from the 1962 deposited map (about 15 m); parts of the Larne borough boundary are traced from the 1956 extension map (about 25 m); Newtownabbey's inland line follows whole townlands read from a small-scale scheme map and is not confirmed. They are drawn dotted on the map.
